highlights.title_zh: YuEEG 升到 Rev E：双 Type-C、AMOLED 显示与 microSD 备份
highlights.title_en: YuEEG Moves to Rev E: Dual Type-C, AMOLED Display and microSD Backup
highlights.brief: YuEEG 在 10 月 27 日凌晨把工程推进到 **Rev E**（一次提交改动 **160 个文件**）：在 Rev D 基础上加入**双 Type-C**——DATA/FLASH 走隔离烧录与 CDC、CHARGE/POWER 独立充电与供电且 VBUS 不并联；新增 **AMOLED 显示**（DWO DO0200PFS12，RM67162 驱动）与 **microSD 备份**，Wi-Fi 输出改为 UDP。采集端仍是 ADS1299 八通道湿电极（500 SPS、增益 12、外部公共 REF、独立 BIAS）＋ESP32-S3。状态说明也同步更新得很克制：只完成静态检查与固件编译，**显示/存储联调、样机烧录、噪声、充放电故障、并发传输、隔离耐压与漏电流全部未验证**。对做低成本 EEG 硬件的团队这是高质量参考设计，但仍是「设计基线」而非可用设备。

highlights.title_zh: MNE-CPP 让 macOS 产线签名可选，并报告「为何没选到签名身份」
highlights.title_en: MNE-CPP Makes macOS Signing Optional and Reports Why No Identity Was Selected
highlights.brief: MNE-CPP 在 10 月 27 日凌晨继续修发布链路（10 次提交）：CI 现在支持对 **macOS dev build 做可选的生产签名与公证**，并新增一条提交专门「**报告为何没有选中签名身份**」（81dd2e8f49）。这条看似琐碎，正对上前一天 v2.4.0 被撤回、改以 v2.4.0-rc 发布的疑点——签名/公证在 CI 上静默失败时，产物在 macOS 上会触发「无法验证开发者」，而日志里什么都没有，只能靠猜。把「为什么没签名」显式写出来，是把发布事故变成可诊断问题的正确做法。同批还包括「docs gate 变绿后部署 dev 网站」。对依赖其 macOS 二进制的用户，建议改用带签名的构建并核对公证状态。

highlights.title_zh: MOABB 加入整数型 PurgedEpochKFold，避免原始 epoch 窗口重叠泄漏
highlights.title_en: MOABB Adds an Integer-Only PurgedEpochKFold Against Raw-Epoch Window Overlap
highlights.brief: MOABB 合并 #1329：新增**整数型 PurgedEpochKFold**，专门处理原始 epoch 窗口重叠导致的泄漏（#280 提出的问题）。这个 PR 刻意做得很小——**只三个文件**（独立 splitter、针对性测试、changelog），并把上位的大 PR #1235 作为「已被取代」关闭，正合「评审友好、可回滚」的做法。技术要点是 purge 边界**只用整数 epoch 索引**计算，不依赖时间戳或采样率，因此在异构数据源上行为一致。对做 EEG 解码的人，窗口重叠是抬高 CV 分数却不报错的最经典陷阱；有显式的 purged splitter，至少能把「泄漏」从隐性假设变成可选配置。建议在做跨被试/跨会话交叉验证时显式启用并记录参数。

items.title_zh: YuEEG 升到 Rev E：双 Type-C、AMOLED 显示与 microSD 备份
items.title_en: YuEEG Moves to Rev E: Dual Type-C, AMOLED Display and microSD Backup
bullets_zh: Rev E 在 Rev D 基础上增加：**双 Type-C**（DATA/FLASH 隔离烧录与 CDC；CHARGE/POWER 独立充电供电，**VBUS 不并联**）、**AMOLED 显示**（DWO DO0200PFS12，RM67162 驱动）与 **microSD 备份**，Wi-Fi 改为 UDP 输出。
采集仍为 ADS1299 八通道湿电极（默认 500 SPS、增益 12、外部公共 REF、独立 BIAS），主控 ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8；本次提交涉及 **160 个文件**，含 Rev E 设计与电气复核文档及完整评审包。
状态声明同步更新：静态检查与固件编译完成，但**显示/存储联调、样机烧录、噪声、充放电故障、并发传输、隔离耐压与漏电流均未验证**，不得视为人体使用放行。
bullets_en: Rev E adds dual Type-C (DATA/FLASH for isolated flashing and CDC; CHARGE/POWER for independent charging and supply with VBUS not paralleled), an AMOLED display (DWO DO0200PFS12, RM67162 driver) and microSD backup, with Wi-Fi switched to UDP.

Acquisition stays ADS1299 eight-channel wet electrode (500 SPS, gain 12, external common REF, independent BIAS) with an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8; the commit touches 160 files including Rev E design review and the full review package.

The status statement is updated honestly: static checks and firmware build only — display/storage integration, prototype flashing, noise, battery fault, concurrent transfer, isolation withstand and leakage current remain unverified, and it is not cleared for human use.
items.brief: YuEEG 在 10 月 27 日凌晨把工程推进到 **Rev E**（一次提交改动 **160 个文件**）：在 Rev D 基础上加入**双 Type-C**——DATA/FLASH 走隔离烧录与 CDC、CHARGE/POWER 独立充电与供电且 VBUS 不并联；新增 **AMOLED 显示**（DWO DO0200PFS12，RM67162 驱动）与 **microSD 备份**，Wi-Fi 输出改为 UDP。采集端仍是 ADS1299 八通道湿电极（500 SPS、增益 12、外部公共 REF、独立 BIAS）＋ESP32-S3。状态说明也同步更新得很克制：只完成静态检查与固件编译，**显示/存储联调、样机烧录、噪声、充放电故障、并发传输、隔离耐压与漏电流全部未验证**。对做低成本 EEG 硬件的团队这是高质量参考设计，但仍是「设计基线」而非可用设备。
items.brief_en: YuEEG advanced to Rev E on Oct 27 Beijing time in a 160-file commit: dual Type-C (isolated flashing/CDC on DATA/FLASH, independent charging on CHARGE/POWER, VBUS not paralleled), an AMOLED display (RM67162 driver), microSD backup and Wi-Fi via UDP, still on ADS1299 with an ESP32-S3. It still states only static checks and firmware builds are done, with integration and safety tests unverified.
items.raw_excerpt: README: 「当前版本为 **Rev E 工程评审版**：ADS1299 + ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8，双 Type-C、隔离 USB、Wi-Fi UDP、AMOLED 与 microSD 备份。」「双 Type-C | DATA/FLASH 隔离烧录/CDC；CHARGE/POWER 独立充电/供电；VBUS 不并联」。「工程已完成静态检查和固件编译，尚未完成样机烧录、显示/存储联调、噪声、充放电故障、并发传输、隔离耐压和漏电流验证。」Commit b16bd38285: "Add Rev E dual USB, AMOLED and SD backup EEG hardware" (160 files).
items.why_valuable: 一天内从 Rev D 推到 Rev E 并交付完整评审包，状态声明仍然诚实克制。

items.title_zh: MNE-CPP 让 macOS 产线签名可选，并报告「为何没选到签名身份」
items.title_en: MNE-CPP Makes macOS Signing Optional and Reports Why No Identity Was Selected
bullets_zh: CI 现在支持对 macOS dev build 做**可选的生产签名与公证（notarization）**，并在未选到身份时**显式报告原因**——正是这类静默失败导致昨天的 v2.4.0 被撤回、改发 v2.4.0-rc。
同批 10 次提交还包括「每次 docs gate 变绿后部署 dev 网站」，属发布链路的可观测性修正。
对下游：签名/公证缺失会让 macOS 用户看到「无法验证开发者」而无法直接运行；把原因写进日志比事后猜更省时间。
bullets_en: CI now supports optional production signing and notarization of macOS dev builds, and explicitly reports why no signing identity was selected — exactly the silent failure that forced yesterday's v2.4.0 withdrawal in favour of v2.4.0-rc.
The batch of ten commits also deploys the dev website after every green docs gate, part of making the release path observable.
Downstream, missing signing/notarization makes macOS users hit 'unidentified developer' blocks, so logging the reason saves the guesswork.
items.brief: MNE-CPP 在 10 月 27 日凌晨继续修发布链路（10 次提交）：CI 现在支持对 **macOS dev build 做可选的生产签名与公证**，并新增一条提交专门「**报告为何没有选中签名身份**」（81dd2e8f49）。这条看似琐碎，正对上前一天 v2.4.0 被撤回、改以 v2.4.0-rc 发布的疑点——签名/公证在 CI 上静默失败时，产物在 macOS 上会触发「无法验证开发者」，而日志里什么都没有，只能靠猜。把「为什么没签名」显式写出来，是把发布事故变成可诊断问题的正确做法。同批还包括「docs gate 变绿后部署 dev 网站」。对依赖其 macOS 二进制的用户，建议改用带签名的构建并核对公证状态。
items.brief_en: MNE-CPP kept fixing its release path on Oct 27 Beijing time: CI now supports optional production signing and notarization for macOS dev builds, plus a commit reporting why no signing identity was selected. That targets yesterday's withdrawn v2.4.0 — silent signing failures produce 'unidentified developer' blocks with nothing in the logs. The dev site deploys after each green docs gate.

Prior day: v2.4.0 withdrew in favour of v2.4.0-rc.
items.why_valuable: 把 macOS 签名静默失败变成可诊断日志，正是前一天撤回 v2.4.0 的根因方向。

items.title_zh: MOABB 加入整数型 PurgedEpochKFold，避免原始 epoch 窗口重叠泄漏
items.title_en: MOABB Adds an Integer-Only PurgedEpochKFold Against Raw-Epoch Window Overlap
bullets_zh: #1329 是一个**刻意最小**的可选跟进（仅三个文件：独立 splitter、针对性测试、changelog），用于解决 #280 提出的**原始 epoch 窗口重叠**问题；上位大 PR #1235 已作为被取代而关闭。
分割器只用**整数 epoch 索引**计算 purge 边界，不依赖时间戳或采样率，便于在不同数据源上保持一致行为。
窗口重叠造成的泄漏会抬高交叉验证分数却不报错，是 EEG 解码里最典型的「看起来很好」陷阱。
bullets_en: #1329 is deliberately minimal (three files: a standalone splitter, focused tests, changelog) and addresses the raw-epoch overlap concern from #280; the larger #1235 was closed as superseded.
The splitter computes purge boundaries from integer epoch indices only, independent of timestamps or sampling rates, keeping behaviour consistent across data sources.
Overlapping windows inflate cross-validation scores without any error — the classic 'looks great' trap in EEG decoding.
items.brief: MOABB 合并 #1329：新增**整数型 PurgedEpochKFold**，专门处理原始 epoch 窗口重叠导致的泄漏（#280 提出的问题）。这个 PR 刻意做得很小——**只三个文件**（独立 splitter、针对性测试、changelog），并把上位的大 PR #1235 作为「已被取代」关闭，正合「评审友好、可回滚」的做法。技术要点是 purge 边界**只用整数 epoch 索引**计算，不依赖时间戳或采样率，因此在异构数据源上行为一致。对做 EEG 解码的人，窗口重叠是抬高 CV 分数却不报错的最经典陷阱；有显式的 purged splitter，至少能把「泄漏」从隐性假设变成可选配置。建议在做跨被试/跨会话交叉验证时显式启用并记录参数。
items.brief_en: MOABB merged #1329 adding an integer-only PurgedEpochKFold for the raw-epoch overlap problem from #280. Deliberately minimal (three files), it supersedes the larger #1235. Purge boundaries derive from integer epoch indices only, not timestamps or rates, so behaviour stays consistent; overlapping windows otherwise inflate cross-validation scores silently.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #1329: "Add minimal integer-only PurgedEpochKFold for raw epoch windows — This is the **minimal opt-in follow-up** requested by @bruAristimunha in #1235 for the raw-epoch-overlap concern in #280. The original large PR #1235 has now been **closed as superseded**. This PR deliberately contains **only three files**: one standalone splitter, focused tests, and the changelog." Merged 2026-10-26T01:09Z.
items.why_valuable: 窗口重叠会静默抬高交叉验证分数，显式 purged splitter 把泄漏变成可控配置。

items.title_zh: MOABB 修 HefmiIch2025：被试其实是别人的会话
items.title_en: MOABB Fixes HefmiIch2025: Its Subjects Were Actually Other People's Sessions
bullets_zh: #1326 修 HefmiIch2025 数据集的被试划分——此前把**别人的会话**当成了独立被试，导致「跨被试」评估实质上是跨会话。
这类元数据错误不会让代码报错，只会让泛化结论偏乐观：同一被试的会话间相关性远高于被试间。
对用该数据集做跨被试基线的团队，建议升级后重跑并核对被试数与分组口径。
bullets_en: #1326 fixes HefmiIch2025's subject split, where sessions belonging to other people had been treated as separate subjects, making 'cross-subject' evaluation effectively cross-session.
Such metadata errors raise no exception; they only make generalisation claims optimistic, since within-subject sessions correlate far more than across subjects.
Teams benchmarking cross-subject performance on this dataset should re-run and check subject counts and grouping after upgrading.
items.brief: MOABB 合并 #1326，修 **HefmiIch2025** 数据集的被试划分问题：此前把**别人的会话**当成了独立被试，导致标称的「跨被试」评估实际上退化成「跨会话」——同一被试不同会话之间的相关性远高于被试之间，于是泛化结论会系统性偏乐观，而且**不会报任何错**。这类数据层元数据错误比算法 bug 更难发现，因为它藏在 «subjects» 字段里，只有在严格按被试分组重跑时才会暴露。对用该数据集做跨被试基线的团队，建议升级后重跑并核对被试数与分组口径；同时这也是提醒：引用公开数据集的「跨被试」结果前，先确认其 subject 划分是否可信。
items.brief_en: MOABB merged #1326 fixing HefmiIch2025's subject split, where sessions belonging to other people had been treated as separate subjects — turning nominal cross-subject evaluation into cross-session evaluation, which inflates generalisation claims without any error. These metadata errors hide in the subjects field and only surface when re-running with strict grouping.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #1326 merged 2026-10-26T00:24Z: "Fix HefmiIch2025 subjects made of other people's sessions: take subjects a[part]". Same day: "Cross-system transfer tutorial: masked-mean MDM with groups=\"device\"" (#1305) and "Add minimal integer-only PurgedEpochKFold (#1329)".
items.why_valuable: 被试划分错会让「跨被试」变成跨会话，泛化结论偏乐观且不报错。

items.title_zh: MNE-BIDS 让 sidecar 无锁读取、原子写入：网络文件系统读快约 40%
items.title_en: MNE-BIDS Reads Sidecars Lock-Free and Writes Atomically: ~40% Faster on Network Filesystems
bullets_zh: #1680：读取 sidecar 不再每次加文件锁（写者旧实现会截断文件再填充，因此读侧必须加锁），改为**无锁读 + 原子写**。
作者实测：**在网络文件系统上读一段记录快约 40%**，单进程与并行写入也更快；这直接改善大型 BIDS 数据集的处理体验。
原子写同时避免了「读到写了一半的 sidecar」这种极难复现的损坏，对多进程/集群流水线尤其重要。
bullets_en: #1680 drops the per-read file lock (needed because the old writer truncated then filled files) in favour of lock-free reads and atomic writes.
The author measured about 40% faster reads of a recording on a network filesystem, with faster writes both alone and in parallel.
Atomic writes also prevent reading half-written sidecars — corruption that is nearly impossible to reproduce, and critical for multi-process or cluster pipelines.
items.brief: MNE-BIDS 合并 #1680：sidecar 读写模型整体换掉——**读取不再加文件锁**，写入改为**原子写**。原因是旧实现写入时会「先截断再填充」，读侧只能靠加锁避免读到半个文件；改成原子替换后，读侧可以完全无锁。作者给出的实测数据很有说服力：**在网络文件系统上读取一段记录快约 40%**，单独写与并行写也都更快。对处理大型 BIDS 数据集、或跑多进程/集群流水线的团队，这不只是速度问题——「读到写了一半的 sidecar」是那种一年遇到一次、却极难复现的损坏，原子写直接消掉了它。建议升级后在共享存储上实测一次读写吞吐。
items.brief_en: MNE-BIDS merged #1680 replacing the sidecar I/O model: reads no longer take a file lock and writes are atomic. The old writer truncated files before filling them, forcing lock-protected reads; atomic replacement removes the lock. The author measured about 40% faster reads on a network filesystem, and it eliminates rare half-written-sidecar corruption.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #1680: "ENH: Read sidecars without a lock and write them atomically … **Reading a recording takes about 40% less time on a network filesystem, and writing is faster alone and in parallel.** On main, every sidecar read takes a file lock, because a writer truncates the file and fil[ls]…" Merged 2026-10-26T21:29Z.
items.why_valuable: 原子写既提速约 40%，又消除「读到半个 sidecar」这类难复现损坏。

items.title_zh: pyRiemann 修 HPD 矩阵的 Shrinkage 收缩
items.title_en: pyRiemann Corrects Shrinkage When Shrinking HPD Matrices
bullets_zh: #510 修 `Shrinkage` 在收缩 **HPD（Hermitian 正定）** 矩阵时的实现问题，与前一日的 `RandomOverSampler`（#508）属同一批 HPD 支持补齐。
收缩估计是协方差正则化的主力手段（样本少、通道多时），收缩目标与系数用错会改变特征值结构，进而影响分类边界。
对使用复数/相位特征或 HPD 场景的团队，建议升级后核对收缩后的矩阵是否仍满足 Hermitian 正定与迹约束。
bullets_en: #510 fixes Shrinkage when shrinking HPD (Hermitian positive-definite) matrices, following the previous day's RandomOverSampler fix (#508) in the same HPD-support push.
Shrinkage is the standard covariance regulariser when trials are few and channels many; a wrong target or coefficient distorts the eigenvalue structure and thus the classifier boundary.
Teams using complex or phase features should verify that shrunk matrices remain Hermitian positive-definite and trace-constrained after upgrading.
items.brief: pyRiemann 合并 #510，修 `Shrinkage` 在收缩 **HPD（Hermitian 正定）矩阵**时的实现问题。这是该库连续第三天补齐 HPD/复数场景支持（10-25 #463 让 `sample_gaussian` 支持数组 sigma 生成 HPD、10-26 #508 修 HPD 过采样、今天 #510 修收缩）。收缩估计是「试次少、通道多」时协方差正则化的主力手段，收缩目标或系数一旦不对，会改变特征值结构——表现为分类边界漂移，而且不报错。对用复数/相位特征做黎曼分类的团队，建议升级后检查收缩后的矩阵是否仍满足 Hermitian 正定与迹约束，并重跑关键对照。
items.brief_en: pyRiemann merged #510 fixing Shrinkage for HPD matrices — the third day of HPD/complex support after #463 and #508. Shrinkage is the main covariance regulariser when trials are few and channels many; a wrong target or coefficient distorts eigenvalue structure and shifts the classifier boundary without error. Verify positive-definiteness and trace after upgrading.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #510 "Correct Shrinkage when shrinking HPD matrices", merged 2026-10-26T11:30Z. Preceding day: "Correct RandomOverSampler when sampling HPD matrices (#508)" 2026-10-20T11:11Z; "generalize sample_gaussian to generate HPD matrices for array sigma (#463)" 2026-10-20T10:31Z.
items.why_valuable: 收缩出错会改变特征值结构并漂移分类边界，且不报错，需核对正定性。
